# GitHub Copilot instructions for GenPRES

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It holds the script-first code policy, the build and test commands, the code locations, the script-based development workflow and the checklist for automated edits, and it lists the instruction files under `.github/instructions/` that hold the coding, formatting and commit-message rules. This file repeats none of it, so there is one copy to maintain.
